name: yuanbao_proto_parse_fields
notes: Protobuf wire-format field parser (yuanbao_proto_helpers.c::yb_parse_fields vs LIVE yuanbao_proto.py::_parse_fields). Inputs are hex-encoded messages. Truncated-varint and truncated-64/32-bit inputs are excluded because LIVE's hand decoder silently returns on truncation where the port fails/stops — a documented divergence outside this input class.
